def positions(grid,n,start):
    H=len(grid); W=len(grid[0]); allowed={1,2}
    # source considered passable when moved from

        for c in range(start[1],start[1]+n):

    valid=set()
    for r in range(H-n+1):
        for c in range(W-n+1):
            if all(grid[i][j] in allowed for i in range(r,r+n) for j in range(c,c+n)):

        p=q.popleft()
        for dr,dc in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
            np=(p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc)
            if np in valid and np not in seen:
                seen.add(np);q.append(np)
